name: Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd
title: Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd - 543227 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 CC growth only 0.5% QoQ and FY26 CC 9.2% missed 10% guide; FY27 12.5% CC organic guide rests on 27% pipeline growth and a 17.5–18.5% margin target, with no supply-side capacity lever in an asset-light IT services model.

utilisation.quote: we are at about 81% compared to 77.4% in the previous year in the same quarter

triggers.label: Pipeline grew 27% in Q4
triggers.quote: during Q4, we saw a record pipeline growth of 27%

triggers.label: Utilisation ~81% vs 77.4% YoY
triggers.quote: we are at about 81% compared to 77.4% in the previous year in the same quarter

triggers.label: DSO up to 94 days from 92
triggers.quote: DSO increased marginally to 94 days from the 92 that we were earlier on

triggers.label: FY26 CC growth 9.2% vs 10% guide
triggers.quote: Growth in constant currency came in at 9.2%, slightly below our guidance that we had made for the year of 10%

guidance.quote: the Board has reconfirmed FY27 growth guidance of 12.5%

prior_guidance_check.quote: Growth in constant currency came in at 9.2%, slightly below our guidance that we had made for the year of 10%
EBITDA margins remained within our guided range of 20% to 22%

red_flags.label: Hi-Tech drop from one customer pause
red_flags.quote: The customer is trying to take it to market and there's a pause in the engagement.

red_flags.label: Attrition 17%, headcount down
red_flags.quote: We ended the year with about 6,500 Happiest Minds, a slight drop from the previous year. While attrition has been high at 17%

evasions.quote: we have traditionally not been giving TCV, ACV because there is no one standard formula adopted by the industry
So it's not profitability. The profitability tends to get captured in the larger PDES and the IMSS area work.
